title: Multi-Secret Block-Matrix Shared CNOT Amortization and Cross-Packet Sum/Difference Peeling
claims: A single CNOT kernel circuit compiled for a shared public header A in Z_{2^t}^{n x K} simultaneously compresses D independent secret packets into the even sublattice.

Applying a cross-packet CNOT between matched-label survivor wires of secrets s^{(1)} and s^{(2)} prepares rho(a, s^{(1)} + s^{(2)}, gamma^2) on Z-outcome b=0 and rho(a, s^{(1)} - s^{(2)}, gamma^2) on Z-outcome b=1.
favorable_controls: Equal-secret control s1=s2=5 mod 8 (b=1 diff branch <X> = +gamma^2)
Pi-difference control s1=5, s2=3, a=2 mod 8 (b=1 diff branch <X> = -gamma^2)
Sum-zero control s1+s2=0 mod 8 (b=0 sum branch <X> = +gamma^2)
